title: AWRP Project-first execution-ready profile (report contract)
description: Machine-readable shape of task_readiness() and of a Project-first ready manifest. Advisory: legacy manifests stay readable and validate; readiness gates creation (strict) and informs doctor. Never rewrites history.

ok.description: True only when every readiness item below holds.

missing.description: Machine-readable missing/invalid item names; empty when ok.

transport.description: Relay identity when a root registry is available; reported, bound at publication.

x-ready-manifest.description: A manifest is execution-ready when all hold; task_readiness() enforces exactly this.
x-ready-manifest.ownership: project owns routing.channel_id in the root registry when a root is available
